dedupe_keys.name: luxembourg seismological network luxsnet waveform data

description: The Luxembourg Seismological Network, LuxSNet, is operated by the European Center for Geodynamics and Seismology to monitor seismic activity in and around Luxembourg continuously and to provide high-quality seismological data for research. According to the GEOFON network page, the first continuous broadband station in Luxembourg was installed in the Walferdange Underground Laboratory in 1994, short-period stations at Kalborn and Vianden have recorded since the 1980s, and further broadband stations were added from late 2009; the network now has 12 broadband stations plus station WLF, equipped with Güralp and Nanometrics sensors. All data is acquired in real time via SeedLink at 200 Hz, and waveforms are available without restriction through the European Integrated Data Archive at the GEOFON data centre under network code LU, updated daily. The network has a DOI (10.7914/HAET-1D18) and DataCite metadata, a station list with a KML file, and a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Caveats: the network is still being developed, and the page separates current and former stations with open, restricted or partial access. Coverage is Luxembourg and the border region. It supports earthquake hazard exposure studies for infrastructure; related records are the CRAAG Algerian seismic network and the INSIVUMEH seismological data of Guatemala.
